rows.label: Account
rows.desc: View your account information

rows.label: Storage usage
rows.desc: {used} of {total} used

rows.label: Shared with me
rows.desc: Group and shared accounts you can manage. Select one to edit its filters, vacation responder, calendars, and contacts.

rows.label: Your name
rows.desc: People see this name next to your address when you send them mail.

rows.label: Your name
rows.desc: People see this name next to your address when you send them mail.

rows.label: Email addresses
rows.desc: The addresses you can send from, each with its own name and signature.

rows.label: Sub-addressing
rows.desc: Use tags like user+tag@domain.com to organize incoming mail

rows.label: Sub-address delimiter
rows.desc: Character separating your username from a sub-address tag. Match the delimiter your mail server uses (e.g. user{delimiter}tag@domain.com).

rows.label: Two-step sign-in
rows.desc: Add an extra layer of security with a time-based one-time password

rows.label: Two-step sign-in
rows.desc: Add an extra layer of security with a time-based one-time password

rows.label: Account security
rows.desc: Manage your password, two-factor authentication, and security settings

rows.label: App lock
rows.desc: Asks for a PIN after a time without use, in every window. While it's locked, the app can't read the mail stored on this device until someone enters the PIN.

rows.label: Lock with a PIN
rows.desc: The PIN stays on this device.

rows.label: Unlock with Windows Hello
rows.desc: Use your face, fingerprint or Windows PIN. The app's PIN keeps working.

rows.label: Lock after
rows.desc: Time without use in any window.

rows.label: Lock now
rows.desc: Locks all windows at once.

rows.label: PIN
rows.desc: If you forget it, the only way back is to remove the data on this device and sign in again. Your mail on the server stays. Messages still waiting to be sent on this device are lost.

rows.label: Passkey
rows.desc: Unlock with a passkey or security key that can protect the key. Not all can, and the PIN keeps working.

rows.label: Refresh sender icons
rows.desc: Fetch the website icons again, for example when a sender changed theirs

rows.label: Show avatars in the Junk folder
rows.desc: Show profile images and favicons for senders in the junk folder. Disabled by default to avoid lending visual legitimacy to phishing attempts.

rows.label: Pause notifications
rows.desc: No sounds, pop-ups or spoken announcements for new mail until you turn this off again.

rows.label: New mail
rows.desc: Configure notifications for incoming emails

rows.label: Email notifications
rows.desc: Show notifications when new emails arrive

rows.label: Sound for new mail
rows.desc: Play an audio alert when new emails arrive

rows.label: Inbox only
rows.desc: Only notify for mail that lands in the Inbox; skip mail a filter files into another folder

rows.label: Unread count on the taskbar icon
rows.desc: So you see new mail while you work in another app.

rows.label: Count unread mail in all accounts
rows.desc: The number on the taskbar icon and in the tray adds up the inboxes of every signed-in account.

rows.label: Calendar notifications
rows.desc: Configure notifications for calendar events

rows.label: Event notifications
rows.desc: Show alerts for upcoming calendar events

rows.label: Sound for reminders
rows.desc: Play an audio alert for calendar reminders

rows.label: Sound
rows.desc: Choose which sound to play for notifications

rows.label: Tone
rows.desc: Select a notification tone and click the speaker icon to preview it

rows.label: Notifications when {appName} is closed
rows.desc: Receive system notifications for new mail when this site is closed. Delivered via the Bulwark push relay; the relay never sees mail content.

rows.label: Push relay
rows.desc: The push relay has been set by your administrator and cannot be changed.

rows.label: Registered devices
rows.desc: Every device registered to receive background notifications for this account. Revoking one stops it receiving immediately.

rows.label: Introductory tour
rows.desc: Replay the guided walkthrough of the interface

rows.label: Show on new devices
rows.desc: Replay the welcome banner and tour the first time you sign in on a new device, even if you've already completed them elsewhere

rows.label: Language, region & time
rows.desc: Language, date format, time format, and other regional preferences

rows.label: Language
rows.desc: Choose your preferred language

rows.label: Date format
rows.desc: How dates are shown in the email list

rows.label: Date format region
rows.desc: How numeric dates are ordered (day, month, year)

rows.label: Time format
rows.desc: Choose between 12-hour or 24-hour clock

rows.label: Time zone
rows.desc: Show the times of mail and appointments in this time zone. If you don't choose one, your computer's time zone is used.

rows.label: First day of week
rows.desc: First day of the week in calendars

rows.label: Default apps
rows.desc: Choose whether email and calendar links open in {appName}.

rows.label: Open email links in {appName}
rows.desc: Clicking an email address on a website starts a new message in {appName}.

rows.label: Open calendar links in {appName}
rows.desc: Clicking a calendar link on a website adds the calendar in {appName}.

rows.label: How links open
rows.desc: Choose whether {appName} opens mailto: and webcal: links in a new tab or reuses an open session. The active-session option needs notification permission so you can click a fallback notification to bring {appName} to the front if the browser blocks focus.
options: Open in active session if possible

rows.label: Appearance
rows.desc: Change how {appName} looks.

rows.label: Light or dark
rows.desc: System follows your device's setting

rows.label: Style
rows.desc: Bento puts every panel on its own tile with summary tiles above your mail. Nordic keeps one calm surface with pill buttons and round avatars.

rows.label: Density
rows.desc: Control spacing and padding across the UI

rows.label: Text size and motion
rows.desc: Text size, fonts, spacing and reduced motion are on the Accessibility page.

rows.label: Themes
rows.desc: Choose from themes deployed by your administrator and built-in presets.

rows.label: Interface layout
rows.desc: Where search, navigation and toolbars sit

rows.label: Mail layout
rows.desc: Where the message list and the open message go on the screen.

rows.label: Toolbar position
rows.desc: Where to show email action buttons (Reply, Archive, Delete, etc.)

rows.label: Show toolbar labels
rows.desc: Display text labels next to toolbar icons. Disable to save space once you are familiar with the icons.

rows.label: Compose button
rows.desc: Where the Compose button sits on a computer. Phones always show it over the message list.

rows.label: Account switcher at the top of the sidebar
rows.desc: Show the account switcher above the folders. Turn this off to switch accounts with your avatar on the navigation rail.

rows.label: Colorful sidebar icons
rows.desc: Give folder and tag icons colors (blue Inbox, red Spam, green Sent and so on). Turn this off for gray icons.

rows.label: Show total message count
rows.desc: Show the total message count next to folders and tags, alongside the unread count. Disable to show only unread counts.

rows.label: Show account avatars on the navigation rail
rows.desc: Display individual account circles at the bottom of the navigation rail for quick switching, with a sign-out button below.

rows.label: Multiple accounts
rows.desc: How your accounts and shared mailboxes appear together.

rows.label: Unified mailbox
rows.desc: Show combined folders (Inbox, Sent, etc.) for the active account and its shared folders. The section only appears when there is something to combine: "Across all accounts" is on with more than one account connected, a group inbox is included below, or All mail, Unread or Starred is on. Those three are separate options that only show up once your admin turns them on.

rows.label: Across all accounts
rows.desc: Merge the unified mailbox across every connected account instead of staying within the active account.

rows.label: Include group inboxes
rows.desc: Also merge shared/group inboxes into the unified view.

rows.label: Tell accounts apart
rows.desc: In the unified views, mark each message with the color of the account it came from.

rows.label: Show shared mail accounts
rows.desc: List the folders of mailboxes shared with you under Shared in the sidebar. Turn off to hide them all, or hide single accounts below. Their calendars and contacts stay.

rows.label: Compact shared mailboxes
rows.desc: Show each shared mailbox as one row that opens its inbox, with its folders below it. Empty ones such as Drafts or Trash are left out.

rows.label: Pro interface (experimental)
rows.desc: Desktop-only power-user layout with multi-tab message browsing and cross-account workflows. The standard interface is unaffected; you can switch back at any time.

rows.label: Provided by your administrator
rows.desc: These apps are set up for everyone and cannot be changed.

rows.label: Sidebar apps
rows.desc: Manage custom apps and links in your sidebar

rows.label: Keep apps loaded
rows.desc: Keep inline apps running in the background when switching between them to avoid reloading

rows.label: Presets
rows.desc: Each preset changes several settings at once. Afterwards they are normal settings you can change one by one, and you can combine presets.

rows.label: Text size
rows.desc: Scales all text in the app. 100% is the normal size.

rows.label: Plain text mail font
rows.desc: For messages sent without formatting.

rows.label: Line spacing
rows.desc: Space between lines of text.

rows.label: Letter spacing
rows.desc: Space between letters.

rows.label: Word spacing
rows.desc: Space between words.

rows.label: Paragraph spacing
rows.desc: Space after each paragraph.

rows.label: Reading width
rows.desc: Keeps lines in messages to about 80 characters, so your eyes don't have to travel as far.

rows.label: Density and toolbar labels
rows.desc: How close together list rows are, and whether toolbar buttons show their names, is set on the Appearance page.

rows.label: Contrast
rows.desc: More contrast makes text, borders and the focus outline darker or lighter on any theme, and underlines links. System follows your device.

rows.label: Underline links
rows.desc: Underlines links in the app and in messages, so they don't depend on colour.

rows.label: Colour-blind-safe colours
rows.desc: Uses tag, folder and calendar colours that stay distinct with red-green or blue-yellow colour blindness.

rows.label: Theme and colour mode
rows.desc: Light, dark and the themes are on the Appearance page.

rows.label: Light background for messages
rows.desc: Showing messages on a light background in dark mode is set on the Reading page.

rows.label: Reduce motion
rows.desc: Turns off sliding panels, transitions and smooth scrolling, also inside messages. System follows your device.

rows.label: Single-key shortcuts
rows.desc: Shortcuts such as j, k, e and # that use one key. Turn them off if you use speech input or press keys by accident. Shortcuts with Ctrl or Alt keep working.

rows.label: Keyboard shortcuts
rows.desc: All shortcuts for the app you're in.

rows.label: Focus outline
rows.desc: The outline around the button, link or field the keyboard is on.

rows.label: Large targets
rows.desc: Makes buttons, checkboxes and other controls at least 44 pixels. System turns this on for touch screens.

rows.label: Actions button on each message
rows.desc: Shows a button on each row that opens the message's actions, so you don't need to hover or right-click.

rows.label: Hover and swipe actions
rows.desc: Which actions appear on message rows.

rows.label: Event previews in the calendar
rows.desc: Whether pointing at an event shows its details is set on the Calendar page.

rows.label: Show messages as
rows.desc: Plain text drops a message's layout, colours and pictures. You can switch each message in the reader.

rows.label: Message text size
rows.desc: Text size inside messages. It stays the same for every message.

rows.label: Smallest text in messages
rows.desc: Enlarges text that a message sets smaller than this.

rows.label: Use my font and colours in messages
rows.desc: Replaces the sender's font, size and colours with yours. This can change how newsletters look.

rows.label: Fit wide messages to the window
rows.desc: Shrinks messages that are wider than the reading pane instead of scrolling sideways.

rows.label: Conversations and preview lines
rows.desc: Grouping by conversation and the preview line under each message are set on the Message list page.

rows.label: Marking mail as read
rows.desc: When a message counts as read, and where you go after deleting or moving it, is set on the Reading page.

rows.label: Notification duration
rows.desc: How long messages such as "Moved to Archive" with their Undo button stay on screen.

rows.label: Confirm before sending
rows.desc: Asks before a message is sent.

rows.label: Confirm before deleting
rows.desc: Asks before a message is deleted, also for single messages.

rows.label: Confirm before archiving
rows.desc: Asks before a message is archived.

rows.label: Warnings before sending
rows.desc: Undo send, and the warnings about a missing subject, a forgotten attachment or placeholder text.

rows.label: Asking before deleting several messages
rows.desc: This is set on the Message list page.

rows.label: Visual alerts
rows.desc: Flashes the window title slowly when new mail or a reminder arrives, and keeps reminders on screen until you close them.

rows.label: Unread counts
rows.desc: How folders and the navigation bar show unread mail.

rows.label: Do not disturb
rows.desc: Pause notifications and set quiet hours on the Notifications page.

rows.label: Sounds and the unread badge
rows.desc: Notification sounds and the unread count on the taskbar icon are set on the Notifications page.

rows.label: Reset accessibility settings
rows.desc: Puts every setting on this page back to its default, or to the one your organisation set. Shared settings such as conversation view stay as they are.

rows.label: Message list
rows.desc: What the list shows, and what a click or swipe does.

rows.label: Group messages by conversation
rows.desc: Show replies together as one conversation instead of as separate messages.

rows.label: Group by date
rows.desc: Show messages under date headers such as Today, Yesterday and Last week. Only applies while the list is sorted by date.

rows.label: Show preview text
rows.desc: Display inline preview text inside the focused one-line message list

rows.label: Show the list as columns
rows.desc: Draw one-line rows as a table with From, Subject, Date and Size columns under a header.

rows.label: Inbox type
rows.desc: Unread first shows your newest unread messages in a section above the rest of the inbox

rows.label: Unread messages shown
rows.desc: How many of your newest unread messages the Unread first section shows

rows.label: Tint list rows by tag color
rows.desc: Shade each message row with its first tag color. Disable to keep rows plain; tag dots and chips still show the color.

rows.label: Show verification codes
rows.desc: Offer the code from sign-in and confirmation emails for one-click copying, in the list for a day and in the message

rows.label: Show attachments in the list
rows.desc: Show attached files under each message, to open them from the list. Compact and extra compact rows show only the paperclip.

rows.label: Show tags in the list
rows.desc: Show tag badges next to the sender or subject in the message list

rows.label: Swipe right action (mobile)
rows.desc: On touch devices, the action performed when you swipe a message to the right in the list.

rows.label: Swipe left action (mobile)
rows.desc: On touch devices, the action performed when you swipe a message to the left in the list.

rows.label: Delete action
rows.desc: What happens when you delete an email
options: Move to Trash and mark as read

rows.label: Archive in
rows.desc: How to organize emails when archiving

rows.label: Confirm before deleting several messages
rows.desc: Ask before moving several selected messages to Trash. Permanent deletion always asks.

rows.label: Permanently delete Junk
rows.desc: Permanently delete emails from the Junk/Spam folder instead of moving them to Trash

rows.label: Emails per page
rows.desc: Number of emails to load at once

rows.label: Search in
rows.desc: Where a new search looks. You can still pick another folder in the search filters.
options: All folders except Spam and Trash

rows.label: Clear search when switching folders
rows.desc: Clicking a folder (Inbox, Sent, …) clears the active search and browses that folder. When off, the search stays applied and re-runs in the folder you switch to.

rows.label: Message list order
rows.desc: How messages are ordered in the list. The server does the ordering, so it covers the whole folder, not just the loaded messages.

rows.label: Apply to all folders
rows.desc: When off, the order applies to the Inbox only; other folders stay chronological.

rows.label: Reading
rows.desc: The open message.

rows.label: Mark as read
rows.desc: When to mark emails as read when opened

rows.label: Return to list after delete, archive, move or mark unread
rows.desc: After deleting, archiving, moving, reporting as spam or marking the open message unread, go back to the message list instead of opening the next message.

rows.label: Message spacing
rows.desc: Padding around the message body in the reader

rows.label: Font for plain text mail
rows.desc: Set together with the other fonts on the Accessibility page.

rows.label: Always show emails in light mode
rows.desc: Render email content in light mode even when the app is in dark mode, avoiding dark mode conversion issues

rows.label: Attachment click action
rows.desc: Choose whether clicking a file attachment previews it or downloads it immediately

rows.label: Show image previews in attachments
rows.desc: Render image attachments as thumbnail cards instead of generic file icons

rows.label: Hide inline images from attachments
rows.desc: Images embedded in the message body are not listed as separate attachments

rows.label: Composing
rows.desc: Writing, replying and sending.

rows.label: Plain text only
rows.desc: Disable the rich text editor and send all emails as plain text only, including replies and forwards

rows.label: Mention recipients with @
rows.desc: Typing @ in the message offers its recipients and inserts the chosen one's first name. Enter or Tab picks the highlighted name.

rows.label: Contacts in @ mentions
rows.desc: Typing @ also offers your contacts and people from the directory. Picking someone who isn't a recipient yet adds them to the message.

rows.label: Right-to-left editing support
rows.desc: Adds a direction button to the composer toolbar so you can set paragraphs left-to-right or right-to-left

rows.label: Replies under the message
rows.desc: A reply or forward opens under its message, which stays readable above it. When off, it takes the whole reading pane, like a new message.

rows.label: Quick reply
rows.desc: Show the quick reply box below messages.

rows.label: Reply from the address it was sent to
rows.desc: Reply from the address the mail was sent to. Useful if you have several addresses.

rows.label: Received address matching
rows.desc: Which received addresses count as yours. Exact address only picks one of your configured identities. Same domain also treats any other address on one of your identity domains as a catch-all alias and rewrites the From header to it. Choose exact address if those addresses are distribution lists rather than aliases.

rows.label: Signature position
rows.desc: Where to insert your signature in replies and forwards. Above the quoted text reads naturally as a closing for the reply; below keeps the original message contiguous.

rows.label: Signature on new mail
rows.desc: Automatically insert your signature when composing a new message. Turn off to start every new message without one.

rows.label: Signature on replies & forwards
rows.desc: Automatically append your signature when replying to or forwarding a message. Turn off to send them without one.

rows.label: Signature delimiter
rows.desc: Prefix the signature with the standard "-- " delimiter line (RFC 3676). Turn off if you'd rather flow straight from your message into the signature.

rows.label: Undo send
rows.desc: Gives you a few seconds to take a message back after you press Send.

rows.label: Attachment reminder
rows.desc: Warn before sending when your message mentions attachments but none are attached

rows.label: Empty subject warning
rows.desc: Ask for confirmation before sending a message with no subject.

rows.label: Placeholder warning
rows.desc: Ask for confirmation before sending a message that still has placeholders like [TIME] or [Your Name], template fields left empty, or unfinished text like TODO or TBD.

rows.label: Signatures
rows.desc: Added at the end of the messages you write. Each address has its own.

rows.label: Email templates
rows.desc: Create reusable email templates with placeholder variables

rows.label: Export & import
rows.desc: Back up your templates or transfer them to another device

rows.label: Proofreading
rows.desc: Underline spelling and grammar mistakes while you write, with suggestions to fix them.

rows.label: Check spelling and grammar while I type
rows.desc: The text you write goes to the proofreading add-on and the service it uses, without your signature or quoted messages. Nothing is sent while a message is set to be signed or encrypted.

rows.label: Writing language
rows.desc: The language you usually write in. Proofreading and spell check use it.

rows.label: Your folders
rows.desc: Click a folder icon to customize it

rows.label: Standard folder roles
rows.desc: Assign which folders are used for standard mailbox roles like Inbox, Sent, Trash, etc.

rows.label: Email tags
rows.desc: Make tags to sort your messages. The tags are saved with your messages on the server.

rows.label: Nested tags
rows.desc: Nest tags underneath other tags and show them as a tree in the sidebar.

rows.label: Email filters
rows.desc: Create rules to automatically sort, label, and manage incoming emails

rows.label: Out of office
rows.desc: Automatically handle incoming emails while you're away

rows.label: From (optional)
rows.desc: Leave it empty to start right away.

rows.label: Until (optional)
rows.desc: Leave it empty to keep replying until you turn it off.

rows.label: Subject
rows.desc: Subject line of the auto-reply

rows.label: Forwarding
rows.desc: Passes incoming messages on to another address, with or without the auto-reply, within the period above (without an end date, until switched off). Spam is not forwarded.

rows.label: Keep in inbox
rows.desc: Otherwise the message is only forwarded: it is not kept in this mailbox, and no filter rule runs on it.

rows.label: Recover deleted items
rows.desc: Mail you deleted for good, for example by emptying Trash, that the server still keeps. Select messages and restore them.

rows.label: Organize invitations as
rows.desc: The calendar address used as organizer when you invite people to events.

rows.label: Show invitations from mail
rows.desc: Detect calendar invitations in email attachments and show calendar actions

rows.label: Show time in month view
rows.desc: Display event times in the month calendar view. On small screens this shows full event entries instead of dots.

rows.label: Light event colors
rows.desc: Show events as a light tint of their calendar color with a colored bar at the start, as in Outlook and on printouts, instead of solid blocks.

rows.label: Timed events in month view
rows.desc: How events with a start time look in the month view. All-day and multi-day events stay bars.

rows.label: Show week numbers
rows.desc: Display week numbers in the mini-calendar

rows.label: Limit visible hours
rows.desc: Show only these hours in the day and week views. Events outside them stay reachable from the arrows at the top and bottom of each day.

rows.label: Hide non-working days
rows.desc: Leave the days you don't work out of the week view. Their events still show in the month, day and agenda views.

rows.label: Free scrolling
rows.desc: Scroll continuously through months, weeks and days instead of one period at a time

rows.label: Event hover preview
rows.desc: Show a detail popover when hovering over calendar events

rows.label: Contact birthday calendar
rows.desc: Show a virtual calendar with birthdays from your contacts

rows.label: Tasks
rows.desc: Show a tasks view in the calendar for managing to-dos

rows.label: Show tasks on calendar
rows.desc: Display tasks on the month, week and day calendar views

rows.label: Tasks as their own app
rows.desc: Give tasks their own icon in the app bar instead of a view in the calendar

rows.label: Calendar management
rows.desc: Create, rename, and customize your calendars.

rows.label: Contact list
rows.desc: How contacts are listed, and contact files to import or export

rows.label: Group by first letter
rows.desc: Show alphabetical section headers in the contact list

rows.label: Sort by last name
rows.desc: Order the contact list by surname so family members appear together

rows.label: Show the directory
rows.desc: List the accounts and groups on your mail server under Directory in Contacts

rows.label: Import contacts
rows.desc: Import contacts from a vCard (.vcf) file

rows.label: Export contacts
rows.desc: Export all contacts as a vCard (.vcf) file

rows.label: Address books
rows.desc: Rename or delete your address books

rows.label: Categories
rows.desc: Rename or delete contact categories

rows.label: Display
rows.desc: Configure how files and folders are displayed

rows.label: Show files as
rows.desc: Choose between grid and list layout

rows.label: Default sort
rows.desc: Choose the default sorting for files

rows.label: Sort direction
rows.desc: Choose ascending or descending order

rows.label: Icons
rows.desc: Configure file icon appearance

rows.label: Show file icons
rows.desc: Display icons next to files and folders

rows.label: Colored icons
rows.desc: Use colorful icons instead of monochrome

rows.label: Show thumbnails
rows.desc: Display image previews instead of icons for image files

rows.label: Behavior
rows.desc: Configure file browser behavior

rows.label: Show hidden files
rows.desc: Display files and folders that start with a dot

rows.label: Downloads
rows.desc: Customize how downloaded emails and attachments are named.

rows.label: Spaces
rows.desc: Replace spaces in the resulting filename with another character.

rows.label: Lowercase
rows.desc: Force the entire filename to lowercase.

rows.label: Strip diacritics
rows.desc: Convert accented letters to their ASCII equivalents (ä → a, é → e). Useful for tools that mangle Unicode filenames.

rows.label: Collapse repeated separators
rows.desc: Collapse runs of spaces, underscores, or dashes to a single character.

rows.label: After export
rows.desc: Optionally move the email after exporting it as .eml.

rows.label: Plugins
rows.desc: Plugins are not available in the demo.

rows.label: Debug mode
rows.desc: Enable detailed logging for troubleshooting

rows.label: Detailed logging
rows.desc: Enable detailed logging for troubleshooting

rows.label: Settings backup
rows.desc: Export your settings to a file and import them on your other devices.

rows.label: Settings sync
rows.desc: Other devices signed in to this account get the same settings.

rows.label: Export settings
rows.desc: Download a copy of your settings

rows.label: Import settings
rows.desc: Restore settings from a file

rows.label: Fix problems
rows.desc: When a view looks stale or wrong, or you want to start over.

rows.label: Refresh cached data
rows.desc: Reload contacts, calendars and folders from the server. You stay signed in.

rows.label: Reset settings
rows.desc: Restore all settings to default values
